# Read-only

A value someone could change but this person cannot right now. It stays in the tab order at full contrast, can be selected and copied, and says why in its caption.

**Kind:** Pattern

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/storybook-docs/patterns/ReadOnly/ReadOnly.mdx`

## The three cases

Read-only is one of three ways to show a value without a way to change it. Pick by whether anyone can change it, and who.

- **Read-only.** Someone can change it; this person cannot right now. Neutral fill, full contrast, the reason in the caption.
- **Plain text.** Nobody ever changes it here. It is a label and a value, not a field.

The third case is Disabled: the value waits on something fixable on this screen. It is faded and out of the tab order, and it is never swapped with read-only.

## Key cases

## Usage

Use Read-only for a value someone could change but this person cannot right now: a session time the supervisor set, a field locked while a process runs, a record another person is editing. The common PLUS case is permission. Content that is never editable is plain text, not a read-only field.

| Who can change it | Show it as | Tab order | Looks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Someone else, or this person later | Read-only field | In | Neutral fill, full contrast, no chevron or calendar, no hover |
| Nobody, ever, here | Plain text: label and value | Out | Text |
| This person, once a prerequisite on this screen is met | Disabled field | Out | Faded, the reason in the caption |

## Alternatives

- For a value nobody changes here, show plain text in a details Section.
- For a field that waits on another on this screen, follow Disabled.
- For a value this person can change but rarely, use `InlineEdit`.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Caption: "Set by your supervisor." | "Read-only", "Locked". |
| Caption: "Locked while the import runs." | "Temporarily unavailable". |
| Group caption: "Session details are set by Lincoln's supervisor." | A caption repeated on every field. |

## Accessibility

- `aria-readonly` on every read-only control that carries the role; it is reachable and read by screen readers with its label and caption.
- Text contrast is unchanged from an editable field.
- The value can be selected and copied with the keyboard.
- The caption is tied to the field, so the reason is read with it.

## Related

- Disabled: use for a prerequisite fixable on this screen.
- Forms: use for the form the read-only field sits in.
- Overflow: use for everything else that may clip; it lands as its own pattern page.
- `TextField`, `TextArea`, `Select`, `DatePicker`, `TimePicker`, `Checkbox`, `RadioGroup`, `Toggle`: the components with `isReadOnly`.

## Best practices

### Keep a read-only field in the tab order at full contrast. {#keep-a-read-only-field-in-the-tab-order-at-full-contrast}

**Checked:** Automatic

It can be reached, read, selected and copied. `isReadOnly` sets `aria-readonly` on the controls that carry the role; the text keeps its color and the fill goes neutral. There is no hover change and the cursor is an arrow.

### Drop the interactive cues. {#drop-the-interactive-cues}

**Checked:** Automatic

`Select` hides its chevron and `DatePicker` its calendar button. `Checkbox`, `RadioGroup` and `Toggle` keep their state and ignore clicks.

### Say why in the caption. {#say-why-in-the-caption}

**Checked:** Review

"Set by your supervisor." "Locked while the import runs." One caption on a group is enough when every field in it is read-only for the same reason.

Do: Read-only at full contrast, with "Set by your supervisor" in the caption.
Don't: A faded value with no reason: out of the tab order and hard to read.

### Show a read-only value whole. {#show-a-read-only-value-whole}

**Checked:** Review

A person who cannot change a value must at least read all of it. A `Select` wraps to show its value; for a `TextArea`, set `rows` so all of it shows.  A TextArea that grows to fit its value is Planned.

### Show never-editable content as plain text. {#show-never-editable-content-as-plain-text}

**Checked:** Review

A field promises an input. A value nobody changes here is a label and a value in a details Section.

Do: A value nobody changes here is plain text.
Don't: A field for a value that was never editable: it promises an input.

### Keep read-only and disabled apart. {#keep-read-only-and-disabled-apart}

**Checked:** Automatic

Disabled is for a prerequisite fixable on this screen and leaves the tab order. Read-only is for content people must read.
